visualReview.executedBy: Codex; every listed original screenshot actually displayed with view_image and inspected
findings: All three actual desktop reference cards at 1440×1000 and all three actual native mobile landscape fullscreen reference pages at 844×390 retain complete original source titles, quoted sentences and locators. Both source rows fit; native controls do not cover reference text.

All three 390px article screenshots show the original quoted text/locators and wrapping source links. Smart quotation glyphs are rendered by the existing MDX typography; no words are removed by the comparison.

All three videos actually played at 1x from 0.2 seconds before the appendix to ended, past their original AAC endpoints. Each reference page was observed. Only this batch was fetched; none of the earlier 13 completed videos was repeated.

All 24 painted seeks (exact first frame, first+0.1ms, middle and last frame in both viewports) were paused without an active native subtitle. Original body SHA, full decoded-frame/audio preservation receipts, exact published storyboard, original chapter identities/starts and first-publication dates passed the local checks.
No browser console/page/media errors or horizontal page overflow were observed.
limitations: Chromium viewport emulation, not physical mobile/iOS Safari.
Only the three changed appendices play at 1x on desktop; no duplicate mobile plays or prior-batch media GETs.
Playback is muted; no human audio/ASR claim. Complete body preservation uses the baseline-SHA-bound full media receipts.
390px embedded video remains small; full reading is inspected in actual native fullscreen at 844×390 and article text.
Citation clicks prevent navigation; source verification is a separate record.
